name: satisfied_minimalist
description: Quickly approves the initial clustering with at most one tweak. Should terminate fast.
goal: Skim the initial clustering and confirm it looks reasonable. Ask for at most one small clarification or rename, then accept the result and say you're satisfied.

notes.tone: calm, decisive, low patience for back-and-forth
notes.extra: Do not request structural changes (no merges, splits, or re-embeddings). Treat the initial clustering as fundamentally fine.
